explanation: Only nonzero at D1: it is high when the previous trial ended in state S2, about 6-8 early in the episode and 9-10 after trial 85, and especially after a rare a1-to-S2 transition, whether or not that trial was rewarded. It is 0 at GO and D2, 0 at D1 after the previous trial reached S1, and it fades to 0-2 after several a2-to-S2 common trials in a row (except near the episode end, where it stays around 7-10).
